schema.description: A grounded answer: prose for the reader, plus every figure it states as a cited row.

answer_markdown.description: The answer for the reader in markdown: no links, no list of sources, no mention of tools, providers or models.

rows.description: Every figure answer_markdown states, one row each, with the retrieved page it was read from.

items.description: One figure read from a retrieved page: whose it is, what it is, its number, what the number measures, its date and its citation.

subject.description: The entity the figure describes, as the source names it: Apple, Banco Popular, Netflix.

symbol.description: The exchange ticker of the security the figure describes, or null.

label.description: What the figure is, in a few words: closing share price, one-year certificate rate, revenue growth FY2025.

value.description: The figure as a plain number: 8.25 for 8.25 percent, 1250000 for 1,250,000.

kind.description: What the value measures: currency for a money amount, percent for a percentage, multiple for a ratio such as a P/E, count for a number of units such as shares.

unit.description: The unit of value: the ISO 4217 code of a money amount such as USD or DOP, % for a percentage, x for a multiple, the thing counted for a count.

as_of.description: The date the source gives for this figure as YYYY-MM-DD, or null when it gives none.

source_url.description: The URL of the retrieved page this figure was read from. Null when it was not read from a page retrieved in this response; such rows are discarded.
